compass.title: Live Compass
compass.heading: Heading
compass.permissionNeeded: Motion sensor access required. Tap Enable Compass.
compass.blockedTitle: Motion sensor blocked. Enable in Safari settings:
compass.blockedStep4: Or: Settings → Safari → Motion & Orientation Access → ON
compass.notSupported: Compass sensor not available on this device
compass.calibrate: Hold flat, move phone in figure-8 to calibrate
compass.relative: Compass is relative (no true north on this device). Calibrate by pointing phone north once.

plan.instructions: Upload image, rotate so top faces true North, pan/scale to fit, then read zone overlay
plan.tapToAdd: Tap plan to add corners. Add at least 3.
